_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in calendar_id (or let `sync.py init` create the calendar and fill it in for you). config.json is gitignored because the calendar id is personal.
_comment_filters: A contest is included if its name matches any include_patterns AND no deny_patterns. Deny always wins. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes. To sync everything, set include_patterns to [".*"] and empty deny_patterns.
